content.short: Wizarre is a turn-based NFT play-and-earn game with magical Wizard battles.
content.description: Wizard is a Web3 game designed for mobile that centers you in the world of NFT creatures called Wizards. Collect rare Wizards, trade them with others, and battle players from around the world. Matches are turn-based, offering a range of tactical decisions to influence outcomes. As you progress, you can level up your Wizards, unlock new abilities, and evolve them into stronger forms. A built-in marketplace lets you buy and sell NFTs to grow your collection.
